name: NextNRG
_note: Seeded from the legacy repo config.js. VERIFY domains, tier and orgId before running scripts/seed-omega-orgs.js --apply. orgId is the email domain users sign in with; domains[] are the HOSTNAMES the portal answers on.
_brandsNote: brands[] is what /api/rfq.js matches a BOM line's manufacturer against (lowercased): a NextNRG-labelled battery, module or controller on a customer's BOM routes its quote request here. Copied onto omega_orgs/{orgId} by scripts/seed-omega-orgs.js; editable on the account page.
